## 0. Libraries and Setup

```{r}
# Libraries imports
library("BAS")
set.seed(42) # for reproducibility
```

## 1. Data Analysis and Pre-processing

> Name: Airline Customer satisfaction link : <https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/raminhuseyn/airline-customer-satisfaction>

```{r}
# Loading the full dataset
rm(list=ls())
data = read.csv("data/Airline_customer_satisfaction.csv")
data = data.frame(data)
dim(data)
```

```{r}
# Pre-processing the full dataset reducing it to 2000 rows
index = sample(1:nrow(data),2000,replace=F)
data = data[index,]
row.names(data) = 1:nrow(data)
data = data.frame(data)
dim(data)
```

```{r}
head(data)
```

```{r}
boxplot(data$Arrival.Delay.in.Minutes ~ data$satisfaction, 
        xlab="satisfaction", ylab="Arrival.Delay", main="Airline")
```

```{r}
# Looking at the unique values for categorical variables
unique(data$satisfaction)
unique(data$Customer.Type)
unique(data$Type.of.Travel)
unique(data$Class)
```

```{r}
# Handling Categorical Variables and creating dummy variables
to_numerical <- function(categorical){
  return (as.numeric(as.factor(categorical)) -1 ) 
}

data$satisfaction <- to_numerical(data$satisfaction)
data$Customer.Type <- to_numerical(data$Customer.Type)
data$Type.of.Travel <- to_numerical(data$Type.of.Travel)

## dummy variables dropping "Business" due to linear dependence
data$Class.Eco <- ifelse(data$Class == "Eco", 1, 0)
data$Class.EcoPlus <- ifelse(data$Class == "Eco Plus", 1, 0)
data$Class <- NULL
```

```{r}
# Seeing Preprocessed Dataset
head(data)
```

```{r}
summary(data)
```

```{r}
# Split data 
train_test_split <- function(dataset, split_percentage){
  test_size = split_percentage * nrow(dataset)
  test_idxs = sample(1:nrow(dataset), test_size)
  test_set = dataset[test_idxs, ]
  train_set = dataset[-test_idxs, ]
  return (list(test = test_set, train = train_set))
}
```

```{r}
splitted_dataset <- train_test_split(data, 0.3)
dim(splitted_dataset$train)
dim(splitted_dataset$test)
```
```{r}
# Storing the train and test set
write.csv(splitted_dataset$test,"data/reduced_test.csv", row.names = F)
write.csv(splitted_dataset$train,"data/reduced_train.csv", row.names = F)
```


## 2. Modeling

```{r}
# Loading train and test set
data_test <- read.csv("data/reduced_test.csv")
data_train <- read.csv("data/reduced_train.csv")
splitted_dataset = list(test=data_test, train=data_train)
dim(splitted_dataset$train)
dim(splitted_dataset$test)
```


```{r}
# Model Selection on the covariates suggested by the professor
model <- bas.lm(satisfaction ~ Age + Seat.comfort + Flight.Distance + Class.Eco + Class.EcoPlus + Departure.Delay.in.Minutes + Arrival.Delay.in.Minutes, 
       data=splitted_dataset$train, prior = "BIC", alpha = 1, modelprior = uniform())
```

```{r}
summary(model)
```

```{r}
# Model selection on all variables
full_model <- bas.lm(satisfaction ~ .,
       data=splitted_dataset$train,
       prior = "BIC",
       alpha = 1,
       modelprior = uniform(),
       include.always = ~ Arrival.Delay.in.Minutes)
```

```{r}
summary(full_model)
```

```{r}
# Get predictions on the test set using the suggested model
preds <- predict(
  model,
  newdata = splitted_dataset$test,
  estimator = "BMA", 
  se.fit=TRUE 
) 

plot(splitted_dataset$test$Inflight.entertainment, preds$fit, col="darkorange", xlab="entertainment", ylab="satisfaction", ylim=c(-0.1,1.1))
points(splitted_dataset$test$Inflight.entertainment, splitted_dataset$test$satisfaction, col="steelblue")
```
